# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. In a culture that often tells men to sit back, stay quiet, and soften their edges, Scripture calls us to something greater. We are told to be watchful, alert to the enemy's schemes. We are told to stand firm, not waver when the storm hits. We are told to act like men—to take responsibility, lead with courage, and protect what matters. And we are told to be strong, not in our own power, but in the strength that comes from faith in Christ.

Strength without faith is arrogance. Faith without strength is passivity. God calls us to both. Every morning you wake up, you have a choice: shrink back or stand up. The battlefield may look different for each of us—your job, your marriage, your kids, your private struggles—but the call is the same. Be watchful. Stand firm. Act like men. Be strong. You were not made to coast through life. You were made for battle, and your Commander has already secured the victory.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, silently repeat: "I will stand firm." Then spend two minutes in prayer, asking God for the strength to lead well today.
